app.name: MY Warranty
app.tagline: Know what you own. Know what's covered.

slide1.title: All your warranties. One place.
slide1.body: Add what you own once, and stop hunting through drawers for receipts.

slide2.title: Know what's covered.
slide2.body: See what your warranty includes, what it doesn't, and who to contact.

slide3.title: Never miss a warranty again.
slide3.body: We'll remind you before cover ends, while you can still do something about it.

slide4.title: Add your first product
slide4.body: It takes about thirty seconds. You can add more whenever you like.

detect.warrantyLikely: We found a likely warranty of {{months}} months. Please check it's right.

coverage.title: Coverage check
coverage.describeBody: Describe the problem in your own words.
coverage.describePlaceholder: e.g. My washing machine makes a loud noise during the spin cycle
coverage.disclaimer: Coverage assessments are based on available warranty documentation and do not constitute a guarantee that a manufacturer or service provider will approve a claim.
coverage.unavailableNoData: We don't have warranty documentation for this product yet, so we can't assess coverage. You can still contact the service provider.
coverage.failed: We couldn't complete the check. Please try again.
coverage.followUpBody: Answering this will make the assessment more reliable than a guess.
coverage.attachmentsStored: Photo attached for service documentation. It was not analysed.
coverage.noPolicyTitle: No warranty document to check against
coverage.noPolicyBody: We won't guess. Add your warranty document and we can check the actual terms.

roleHelp.importer: Who brought it into the country

matchHelp.verified: We've confirmed this warranty against the official document.
matchHelp.strong: This matches your model, country and importer.
matchHelp.needs_confirmation: We found a likely warranty but couldn't confirm it for your exact product.
matchHelp.unknown: We couldn't confidently find the warranty for this product.

warrantyIntel.conflictDuration: One source says {{chosen}} months, another says {{alternative}} months.

recommendedWhy.request_pickup: A courier can collect it, so you do not have to carry it.

recommendedWhy.visit_centre: This product has to be brought in.
recommendedWhy.contact: Start by getting in touch — they will tell you how they handle it.

warrantyExpired.title: {{name}} warranty has ended

paywall.title: Get more from MY Warranty
paywall.limitReachedBody: Upgrade to keep adding products. Everything you've already saved stays exactly where it is.
paywall.aiCoverage: Coverage checks are part of Plus
paywall.smartScan: Receipt scanning is part of Plus
paywall.freeFeatures: Up to 3 products · Manual entry · Receipt storage · Expiry reminders
paywall.plusFeatures: Up to 20 products · Coverage checks · Receipt scanning · Automatic warranty detection · Service provider lookup
paywall.proFeatures: Unlimited products · Priority coverage checks · Full warranty archive · Advanced claim help
paywall.renewalNote: Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel any time in your account settings.
